status.codeDrift: Code drift: running {running} ≠ head {head} — restart needed to pick up the latest checkout
status.offPin: Off the cluster pin (head {head}) — this node missed a rollout
status.settleHold: A deploy's settle hold is still waiting on this host: it acked its self-update and had not converged when the rollout exited. Recorded by the lease, not a live check — the off-pin / code badges are the live verdicts. While the hold stands, deploys are refused and auto-rollback is suppressed.
status.rolloutStarted: Cluster rollout started — agents will restart on new code; watch per-host status below. (session {session}, log: {log})
status.rolloutInFlight: A rollout is already in flight — wait for it to finish, then retry.
status.restartStarted: Cluster restart started — services bounce on the current code (no pull); agents finish their turn then restart. (session {session}, log: {log})
status.restartInFlight: A restart/rollout is already in flight — wait for it to finish, then retry.
status.restartConfirm:
Restart the whole cluster on the current code?

No git pull — every service bounces to apply config changes. Agents finish their current turn, then restart.
status.replaySides: Replays the interrupted rollout and restarts all services.
status.commitsBehind: {count, plural, one {# commit behind.} other {# commits behind.}}
status.rollbackAnchor: The cluster's rollback anchor — `ava cluster rollback` with no target falls back to this commit.
status.restartInProgress: cluster restart in progress — services bounce, agents finish their turn then restart
status.rolloutInProgress: cluster rollout in progress — every host finishes its turn then restarts on new code
status.updateRestarts: ↑ {count} {count, plural, one {commit} other {commits}} behind — Update restarts {sides}
status.orchestrationDied: Its orchestration died without reporting an outcome — the deploy lease it held is gone.
status.recoveredDetail: The cluster is running on a commit that works, so there is nothing to repair here — but the code it is running is not the one that was being rolled out.
status.pinAdvancedDetail: The gateway reached the target and the cluster pin advanced, so hosts still off it converge via their watchdog.
status.pinUnchangedDetail: The cluster pin was left where it was, so nothing is converging toward the failed target — a node showing a sha mismatch here is a consequence of this failure, not a separate problem.
status.sinceThen: Since then: {host}. A rollback is the cluster falling back to its last-known-good anchor, not drift.
status.rolloutLogBefore: The rollout's own log is on the gateway under
status.rolloutLogAfter: . The next successful update replaces this record.
status.stagingTitle: Staging host — visible here but excluded from cluster rollouts
